messages:
ops-bot: :warning: ALERT: Streaming tail p99 spike detected for /v1/stream (eu-region). SLO breached.
maria: saw it, grabbing oncall.
aj: I'm oncall, looking at dashboards now. p95 180ms -> 650ms, p99 1.8s -> 6.2s. Tail latency on streaming.
sylvia: noticing packetized chunks in proxy logs — some connections show long gaps between writes.
ken: are we seeing client slow consumers? any recent deploys to streaming-proxy?
paul: no deploys in last 2h. infra autoscaler did a scale-up ~90m ago.
emma: adding traces from trace-id 0a3f... showing write stalls inside streaming-proxy before backend sends tokens.
maria: ok triage plan: 1) confirm scope (regions/customers) 2) attempt traffic reroute to fallback proxy pool 3) if mitigates, keep fallback and roll back suspected change 4) collect logs + open SEV.
aj: scope: eu-only, affected ~2.3% of streaming requests, but 5 customers on high-traffic plans reporting degraded UX.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-827 (auto) — paging #oncall
sylvia: quick check — running query for proxy write latency:

```
SELECT app, p95_ms, p99_ms FROM proxy_stream_metrics
WHERE region='eu' AND window='5m'
```

results: p95 640ms, p99 6.3s, error-rate ~0.2%
ken: logs show repeated `EPIPE` followed by long pause then re-sends. suspect keepalive/heartbeat negotiation with client or ALB idle timeout.
paul: ALB idle timeout was 60s unchanged. But streaming-proxy had a recent socket-keepalive tweak in config (merge 0b12c) ~2h ago.
emma: can we toggle revert on N mid-tier hosts to test? we can target a subset with reroute rule.
aj: I'm going to enable fallback route: route streaming eu -> streaming-proxy-fallback group (no keepalive tweak). Doing a canary on 10%.
maria: command:
```
redwoodctl routes patch --service=streaming --region=eu --set=fallback=10%
```

(aj executes)
aj: done. Canary at 10% now.
(3m)
aj: metrics for canary: p95 -> 210ms, p99 -> 720ms for canary subset. Main pool still high.
sylvia: good sign. Increase to 50%?
ken: caution: fallback pool has lower capacity but should handle burst. Increase to 30% then monitor.
aj: bumped to 30%.
(5m)
aj: overall p95 dropped to 300ms, p99 1.2s. Error-rate steady.
maria: looks like the keepalive change on main pool introduced stall windows in proxy causing buffering before flush.
paul: mitigation path: 1) revert keepalive tweak in main pool config 2) keep fallback routing until fully reverted and validated 3) roll restart streaming-proxy hosts in controlled batches.
emma: putting steps in runbook.
sylvia: log snippet showing stall window:

```
[2026-03-15T12:02:13Z] stream-proxy-12 write start 0.0ms
[2026-03-15T12:02:13Z] stream-proxy-12 write end 2400ms
[2026-03-15T12:02:15Z] stream-proxy-12 flush
```

ken: that 2.4s stall matches p99 spikes.
aj: I'm reverting the config on main pool (git revert 0b12c) and triggering config push to 8 hosts.

```
git revert 0b12c
infra deploy --service=streaming-proxy --hosts host[01-08]
```

(7m)
aj: revert pushed, starting rolling restart.
maria: notify support and affected customers (prelim): "we are investigating streaming delays in EU, mitigation in progress, reduced impact expected within 15-30 minutes".
paul: sending customer comms draft.
ops-bot: Pager duty notified: escalation to Platform Ops.
(12m)
aj: restarts complete for first batch 8 hosts. Observed p99 drop in eu-main from 6.3s -> 1.1s.
emma: full revert completed on all main hosts.
aj: disabling fallback routing, shifting all traffic back.

```
redwoodctl routes patch --service=streaming --region=eu --set=fallback=0%
```

maria: metrics now: p95 220ms, p99 700ms, error-rate normalized. Monitoring.
sylvia: collecting final logs and attaching to INC-2026-827. Root cause hypothesis: keepalive/heartbeat config caused intermittent proxy write buffering under certain client patterns (slow-consumer + ALB idle + config tweak) — regression from config tweak 0b12c.
ken: action items:
- infra: add canary flag gating for keepalive changes (ken)
- runtime: add detection alert for write-stall >1s (sylvia)
- devex: update runbook with reroute steps (emma)
- support: customer follow-up + RCA (maria/paul)

maria: marking handoff to postmortem and closing live triage. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-827 moved to 'mitigated' and assigned PM: maria
